packages.description: Rename from Metadata - rename takes or source files from BWF / iXML metadata with tokens (GUI)
about: Two GUI tools that build names from BWF / iXML metadata tokens ($trk, ${interleave}, ${chnum}, scene / take, ...)
- Rename Active Take from File Metadata: take names and take notes
- Rename Source File from Metadata: renames the media files on disk and relinks them

Beta Testing/hsuanice_Rename Source File from Metadata.lua

packages.description: Item List - spreadsheet-style table of items with metadata columns (Browser + Editor)
about: Spreadsheet-style tables of items with track / take / note / source and metadata columns
- Item List Editor: live table of the selected items with inline editing, copy / paste and export (TSV / CSV)
- Item List Browser: based on the Editor, with browsing and filtering features for larger sessions

packages.description: BWF / iXML Embed Tools - write timecode, iXML / BWF metadata and SMPTE UMID into files (BWF MetaEdit)
about: Write metadata into WAV files with the BWF MetaEdit command-line tool (bwfmetaedit):
- Embed iXML and BWF Metadata from Take 1 to Active Take (with SMPTE UMID option)
- Timecode Embed Tool: TimeReference to BWF + iXML, from Take 1 or the item position
- SMPTE UMID Generate and Embed Tool (bext:UMID)
Requires BWF MetaEdit: https://mediaarea.net/BWFMetaEdit (macOS: brew install bwfmetaedit).
